verdict.outcome_basis: readout: "time to first occurrence of any major adverse cardiovascular event (MACE) from the composite of myocardial infarction (heart attack), stroke" (announcement:stability)

report.headline: STABILITY trial of darapladib failed to reduce MACE in stable coronary heart disease (HR 0.94, p=0.199), consistent with a non-causal Lp-PLA2 target.
report.summary: The STABILITY trial randomized 15,828 patients with stable coronary heart disease to darapladib 160 mg or placebo, targeting a 15.5% relative risk reduction with 90% power and 1,500 planned primary endpoint events over a median 3.51 years follow-up. The trial did not meet its primary endpoint of cardiovascular death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, or nonfatal stroke (HR 0.94, p=0.199). Genetic evidence shows no causal link between PLA2G7 and coronary heart disease (Open Targets score 0.0), and the calculator predicts no benefit (expected HR 1.0, causal RRR 0%). Safety was acceptable with no major imbalance in serious adverse events. Confidence in the failure assessment is medium, limited by the calculator's internal inconsistency on target genetics classification.
key_evidence: Primary endpoint: composite of CV death, nonfatal MI, nonfatal stroke (Study design and rationale for the clinical outcomes of the STABILITY Trial)
1,500 planned primary endpoint events (Study design and rationale for the clinical outcomes of the STABILITY Trial)
90% power, 15.5% assumed RRR (Study design and rationale for the clinical outcomes of the STABILITY Trial)
Observed HR 0.94, p=0.199 (GSK announces top-line results from pivotal Phase III study of darapladib in chronic coronary heart disease)

Lp-PLA2 inhibition 49-67% in phase 2 studies (Effect of darapladib on plasma lipoprotein-associated phospholipase A2 activity in Japanese dyslipidemic patients; The effect of darapladib on plasma lipoprotein-associated phospholipase A2 activity and cardiovascular biomarkers in patients with stable coronary heart disease)
report.what_would_change_this: A positive Mendelian randomization study showing PLA2G7 variants associate with reduced CHD risk, or a trial in a population with confirmed high Lp-PLA2 activity and genetic evidence of causality, would be needed to overturn the conclusion that Lp-PLA2 inhibition is not a valid cardiovascular target.
report.readthrough_note: The SOLID-TIMI 52 trial in acute coronary syndrome (NCT01000727) also failed, reinforcing that darapladib does not reduce cardiovascular events across different coronary populations. No other Lp-PLA2 inhibitor programmes are known to be active.

mechanism.notes: Trial read out (announcement 2013-11-12) with HR 0.94 (p=0.199). Median follow-up 3.51 years per CT.gov. No placebo-adjusted Lp-PLA2 activity change found in verified facts for STABILITY; all phase 2 data (40mg, 80mg, 160mg) are within-arm reductions (49-67%). Actual primary event count not reported in provided facts. Observed CI not provided; p=0.199 from announcement.

issues.issue: Calculator input has pct_change: null for Lp-PLA2 activity change. Protocol requires placebo-adjusted phase 2 change at dose closest to outcome trial (160 mg daily for STABILITY). Verified facts contain only within-arm (placebo_adjusted: false) phase 2 values. No placebo-adjusted phase 2 value is present in verified facts — this is a data gap, not a reason to set null.
issues.request: Search for placebo-adjusted Lp-PLA2 activity change in phase 2 darapladib studies at 160 mg daily (or closest dose). Key papers: pmid:18765397 (12-month), pmid:23439604 (4-week). Extract or compute placebo-adjusted percent change.

issues.issue: Verifier reports 'not_found' for five biomarker change facts (f_135931bbfdbe36, f_009419ed8d9656, f_04cb0280d36985, f_87f5342586db75, f_da230f66d51616). Abstracts do not contain the specific numbers or dose/timepoint mappings recorded. These facts may be from full-text only or mis-extracted.
issues.request: Re-verify each biomarker change fact against full-text PDFs or supplementary materials. Ensure dose, timepoint, and placebo-adjustment status are explicitly documented in the source.

issues.issue: Follow-up input uses 3.51 years from f_16d7463436339e (median_followup), but Verifier notes the source reports 'average of 3.51 years', not median. Calculator time_factor (0.819) depends on this value.
issues.request: Confirm whether STABILITY reported median or mean follow-up in the primary publication (NEJM 2014;370:1702-11). Use median if available; otherwise note the discrepancy.

issues.issue: Calculator inputs events: null and observed_ci: null. Trial planned 1500 primary endpoint events (f_a0c1eb4b96d809). Topline announcement (f_a8e0244ebb00ca, f_657bee909078f2) may report actual event count and HR confidence interval. These should be included for power/MDE calculations and consistency checks.
issues.request: Search STABILITY topline announcement (2013-11-12) and primary publication for actual primary endpoint event count and 95% CI for HR 0.94.

issues.issue: Automatic check flags 'Lp-PLA2 activity change uses within-arm values' but calculator input explicitly states pct_change: null and method: 'no placebo-adjusted phase 2 or phase 3 biomarker change available'. The flag appears to misread the input; no action needed on calculator but document for clarity.
issues.request: Note in assumptions that biomarker change is null due to absence of placebo-adjusted phase 2 data in verified facts, not due to missing phase 3 data.

issues.issue: Biomarker change input is null (pct_change: null) despite guidance requiring placebo-adjusted phase 2 change at the outcome trial dose (160 mg). Verified facts contain only within-arm (placebo_adjusted: false) phase 2 values at 160 mg: f_87f5342586db75 (-59% at 12 months) and f_da230f66d51616 (67% at 4 weeks). No placebo-adjusted data exists in verified facts. Per guidance, missing phase 3 biomarker data is a caveat (medium) but never a reason to drop a quantified input or set to null; the mechanism analyst must extract placebo-adjusted phase 2 change at 160 mg from full texts or the case builder must add it as a verified fact.
issues.request: Extract placebo-adjusted Lp-PLA2 activity change at 160 mg from phase 2 full-text publications (pmid:18765397, pmid:23439604) and populate calculator input with cited source; if unavailable, add within-arm value with explicit caveat and severity medium.

issues.issue: Follow-up years uses 3.51 years from f_16d7463436339e, but verifier confirms this source reports 'average of 3.51 years', not median. Calculator time_factor (0.819) depends on this value. Median follow-up from the primary publication (NEJM 2014;370:1702-11) should be used if available; otherwise the discrepancy must be noted as a caveat.
issues.request: Search for median follow-up in STABILITY primary publication (NEJM 2014) or registry; update followup_years to median if different from 3.51, or add caveat that average was used.

issues.issue: Hypotheses reference SOLID-TIMI 52 outcome ('SOLID-TIMI 52 also failed') but no verified fact ID is provided for SOLID-TIMI 52 result. Verified facts contain only design parameters (assumed RRR, follow-up, sample size, power) not the trial outcome. Claims about another trial's result require a verified fact citation.
issues.request: Add verified fact for SOLID-TIMI 52 primary outcome result (HR, p-value, readout statement) from its announcement or publication, or remove unsupported references to SOLID-TIMI 52 failure from hypotheses.

issues.issue: Automatic check flags that Lp-PLA2 activity change 'uses within-arm values' from cited PMIDs, but calculator input explicitly sets pct_change: null with method stating no placebo-adjusted data available. The check appears to detect within-arm values in the cited sources (pmid:18765397, pmid:20934559, pmid:23439604) even though calculator does not use them. Clarify whether calculator should use within-arm phase 2 data as proxy (with caveat) when no placebo-adjusted data exists.
issues.request: Resolve automatic check: either populate pct_change with within-arm phase 2 value at 160 mg (e.g., -59% at 12 months from f_87f5342586db75) with explicit 'within-arm, not placebo-adjusted' caveat, or confirm null is correct and suppress check.

issues.issue: Biomarker_not_causal hypothesis 'for' section cites genetics facts (f_5e0c73bab87e29, f_b402497cad0944) for the claim 'Genetic evidence indicates Lp-PLA2 activity is not causal for CHD... so biomarker movement does not translate to clinical benefit.' These facts show genetic association score 0.0 and null MR (OR 0.82-1.17) but do not explicitly state the biomarker translation logic. Citation should reference the target_not_causal hypothesis logic or a fact explicitly linking genetics to biomarker non-causality.
issues.request: Rephrase hypothesis to cite target_not_causal hypothesis reasoning, or add a verified fact that explicitly states genetic evidence implies Lp-PLA2 biomarker non-causality.

issues.issue: Automatic check flags 'HDL-C change has no fact citation' but intended biomarker is Lp-PLA2 activity, not HDL-C. This appears to be a generic lipid-biomass trigger; no action needed for HDL-C, but the Lp-PLA2 activity citation gap is addressed in issue 1.
issues.request: No change for HDL-C; address Lp-PLA2 activity citation via issue 1.
